item.title: UK ministers look at quick ways to limit NDAs after Walliams allegations
item.description: Government considers further curbs on non-disclosure agreements after Guardian investigation of TV personality Ministers are looking at ways to change the law quickly to expand protections that stop non-disclosure agreements being used to cover up harassment or discrimination in the wake of the allegations about David Walliams . This could involve extending measures that mean an NDA cannot be used this way to silence an employee so that it also applies to others, such as freelancers or volunteers. Continue reading... item.title: UK ministers have no plans to publish explosive report on climate crisis
item.description: Andy Burnham’s newly appointed climate adviser used report to warn of national security risk from collapsing ecosystems The UK government still has no plans to publish an explosive report showing the national security risk from the collapse of ecosystems around the world – even after handing the key official behind the report a new advisory role. Andy Burnham addressed the Cop31 climate summit in Turkey on Thursday and said the UK was determined to reach net zero by 2050 and work with its partners to build a clean energy future. item.title: Israel to ban far-left French politician Jean-Luc Mélenchon from entry
item.description: The Israeli government said Thursday that it would ban far-left French leader Jean-Luc Mélenchon from entering the country after the French presidential contender said he would use French vessels to force aid into Gaza if he were elected. item.title: Nvidia busca CEO tras la salida de Jensen Huang: estos son los candidatos que suenan para el puesto
item.description: Nvidia ha perdido al único director ejecutivo que ha tenido jamás. Jensen Huang ha dimitido este jueves como presidente, director ejecutivo y miembro del consejo de administración, y la empresa ahora tiene que encontrar a alguien para dirigir al fabricante de chips más valioso del mundo. Por el momento, el puesto pertenece a alguien de la casa. Qué ha pasado. Nvidia anunciaba que su directora financiera, Colette Kress, actuará como directora ejecutiva interina mientras mantiene su cargo financiero, y que el consejo buscará candidatos internos y externos para el puesto permanente. item.description: Swedish activist criticised world governments for their failure to prevent environmental breakdown The planet is “not dying, it is being killed and we know by who”, said Greta Thunberg, who excoriated world governments for their failure to prevent environmental breakdown in her first appearance at the annual UN climate talks in five years. Thunberg , 23, the Swedish activist who became famous for heading the school climate strike movement, delivered her stark message to those gathered at the Cop31 summit in Antalya, Turkey, amid the ongoing failure by countries to adequately address the… Publicado también por: The Guardian - Environment. item.description: Desde su regreso al poder, el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, se ha propuesto transformar la capital del país, Washington D. C., para dejar en ella su sello personal. Tras intervenir en el Kennedy Center, impulsar la construcción de un salón de baile en la Casa Blanca y modificar el estanque reflectante del Monumento a Lincoln, Trump tiene ahora especial interés en levantar un “arco triunfal” de 79 metros de altura, un proyecto que, según afirma, busca conmemorar el 250.º aniversario de Estados Unidos. item.title: Cop31: “No one is coming to rescue us” Greta Thunberg tells climate summit
item.description: World leaders including UK prime minister Andy Burnham are addressing the summit today, as talks head into the third day Zack Polanski , leader of the Green party in the UK, criticised Andy Burnham’s Cop31 speech on Radio 4’s Today programme. Saying he was “not at all reassured” by the prime minister’s words, he described it as a “bizarre” speech. Polanski said climate action is about what you do, not what you say, referring to the recent decision by the energy secretary, Miatta Fahnbulleh , to allow drilling in the Jackdaw gasfield in the North Sea. It’s “one step forwards, two steps back”… Fuente: The Guardian - Environment.
